title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 16 章‧經期婦女
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
ýat ahmi nmâne ýat mâzdayasnôish
nâirika cithravaiti daxshtavaiti vohunavaiti nishhidhât
kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If there be
in the house of a worshipper of Mazda a woman who has the whites
or sees blood, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若在阿胡拉‧馬茲達的信徒的房舍中，有一個婦女患白帶或見血，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的信徒應當如何行？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtadha hê
aête mazdayasna pañta vîcinaêta pairi
urvarâbyasca varedhâbyasca aêsmaêibyô
hiku pãsnu gâtu nidhayaêta fratara haca nmâna
verezyãn ýat vâ naêmem ýat vâ
thrishum ýat vâ cathrushum ýat vâ pangtanghum
ýezi nôit nâirika âtrem aiwi- vaênât
ýezi nôit nâirika âthre raoxshnãn
paiti-didhyât.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall clear the way of the wood
there, both plants and trees; they shall strew dry dust on the
ground; and they shall isolate a half, or a third, or a fourth,
or a fifth part of the house, lest her look should fall upon the
fire.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他們應當在那處清淨木料之地，無論草木；他們應當在地上鋪散乾塵；他們應當隔離房舍的二分之一，或三分之一，或四分之一，或五分之一，免得她的目光落在火上。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... cvat drâjô haca âthrat
cvat drâjô haca apat cvat drâjô haca baresmen
frastairyât cvat drâjô haca nerebyô ashavabyô.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How far from
the fire? How far from the water? How far from the consecrated
bundles of Baresma? How far from the faithful?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！距離火多遠？距離水多遠？距離聖別的巴雷斯瑪束多遠？距離信徒多遠？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, pañca-dasa-gâim
haca âthrat pañca-dasa-gâim haca apat pañca-dasa-gâim
haca baresmen frastairyât thrigâim haca nerebyô
ashavabyô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Fifteen paces from the fire, fifteen
paces from the water, fifteen paces from the consecrated bundles
of Baresma, three paces from the faithful.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「距離火十五步，距離水十五步，距離聖別的巴雷斯瑪束十五步，距離信徒三步。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... cvat drâjô ava-hishtât
aêsha ýô nâirikayå cithravaityå
daxshtavaityå vohunavaityå hvarethem frabarât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How far from
her shall he stay, who brings food to a woman who has the whites
or sees the blood?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！為患白帶或見血的婦女送食物的人應當距離她多遠？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrigâim ava-hishtât
aêsha ýô nâirikayå cithravaityå
daxshtavaityå vohunavaityå hvarethem frabarât
cinem hvarethem frabarât cinem ýaom frabarât
ayanghaênem vâ srum vâ nitema xshathra vairya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Three paces from her shall he stay,
who brings food to a woman who has the whites or sees the blood.'
In what kind of vessels shall he bring her bread? In what
kind of vessels shall he bring her barley-drink?
'In vessels of iron, or of lead, or of any common metal.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「為患白帶或見血的婦女送食物的人應當距離她三步。」他應當用什麼樣的器皿為她送麵包？他應當用什麼樣的器皿為她送大麥飲料？「用鐵製的器皿，或鉛製的器皿，或任何尋常金屬製的器皿。」

segments.orig:
cvat hvarethem frabarât cvat ýaom frabarât,
dva danare tâyûirinãm aêva danare xshaodrinãm
ýezi nôit nâirika niuruidhyât, ýezi
aperenâyûkô frâshnavât zasta hê
paoirîm frasnâdhayen aêtahe ýat aperenâyûkahe
ahe havayåse tanvô.
segments.en:
How much bread shall he bring to her? How much barley-drink
shall he bring?
'Two danares of dry bread, and one danare of liquor, lest
she should get too weak.
'If a child has just touched her, they shall first wash his
hands and then his body.
segments.zh: 他應當為她送多少麵包？他應當送多少大麥飲料？「兩達納爾的乾麵包，和一達納爾的酒液，免得她過於虛弱。」「若一個小孩剛觸摸過她，他們應當先洗小孩的手，然後洗他的身體。」

segments.orig:
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê thrâyô xshafna sacåñte
airime gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta vîspem
â ahmât ýat hê cathwârô xshafna
sacåñte, ýezi nâirika vohunîsh
aiwi-vaênât ýat hê cathwârô
xshafna sacåñte airime gâtûm hê
nishhidhaêta vîspem â ahmât ýat
hê pañca xshafna sacåñte.
segments.en:
'If she still see blood after three nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until four nights have
passed.
'If she still see blood after four nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until five nights have
passed.
segments.zh: 「若她在三夜過去後仍見血，她應當在虛弱之地坐著，直到四夜過去。」「若她在四夜過去後仍見血，她應當在虛弱之地坐著，直到五夜過去。」

segments.orig:
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê pañca xshafna sacåñte
airime gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta vîspem
â ahmât ýat hê xshvash xshafna sacåñte,
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê xshvash xshafna sacåñte airime
gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta vîspem â
ahmât ýat hê hapta xshafna sacåñte.
segments.en:
'If she still see blood after five nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until six nights have passed.
'If she still see blood after six nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until seven nights have
passed.
segments.zh:
『如果女人經過五個夜晚後仍然見血，她應當坐在不潔之處，直到六個夜晚經過。
『如果女人經過六個夜晚後仍然見血，她應當坐在不潔之處，直到七個夜晚經過。

segments.orig:
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê hapta xshafna sacåñte airime
gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta vîspem â
ahmât ýat hê ashta xshafna sacåñte,
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê ashta xshafna sacåñte airime
gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta vîspem â
ahmât ýat hê nava xshafna sacåñte.
segments.en:
'If she still see blood after seven nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until eight nights have
passed.
'If she still see blood after eight nights have passed, she
shall sit in the place of infirmity until nine nights have
passed.
segments.zh:
『如果女人經過七個夜晚後仍然見血，她應當坐在不潔之處，直到八個夜晚經過。
『如果女人經過八個夜晚後仍然見血，她應當坐在不潔之處，直到九個夜晚經過。

segments.orig:
ýezi nâirika vohunîsh aiwi-vaênât
ýat hê nava xshafna sacåñte âat
hê paityârem ava-bareñti daêva daêvanãm
ýasnâica vahmâica, aêtadha hê aête
mazdayasna pañta vîcinaêta pairi urvarâbyasca
varedhâbyasca aêsmaêibyô.
segments.en:
'If she still see blood after nine nights have passed, this
is a work of the Daevas which they have performed for the worship
and glorification of the Daevas.
'The worshippers of Mazda shall clear the way of the wood
there, both plants and trees;
segments.zh:
『如果女人經過九個夜晚後仍然見血，這是迭瓦所行之工，他們為了迭瓦的崇拜與頌讚而行此事。
『馬茲達的信仰者應當清除該處木叢的通路，無論植物與樹木；

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê aête mazdayasna ainghå
zemô thrish makhem ava-kanayen dva makha frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush ôyum âpô xrafstrem
ava-janaêta maoirîm dânô-karshem ýat
vâ hama duye saite kahyâcit angrô-mainyavanãm
xrafstranãm ava-janyât ýat vâ aête
zaêna.
segments.en:
'They shall dig three holes in the earth, and they shall
wash the woman with gomez by two of those holes and with water by
the third.
'They shall kill Khrafstras, to wit: two hundred
corn-carrying ants, if it be summer; two hundred of any other
sort of the Khrafstras made by Angra Mainyu, if it be winter.'
segments.zh:
『他們應當在土地中挖三個洞，並以兩個洞處的牲畜尿清洗該女人，以第三個洞處的水清洗她。
『他們應當殺死克拉夫斯特拉，即：如果是夏季，應當殺死兩百隻穀物搬運蟻；如果是冬季，應當殺死安格拉‧曼紐所造的任何其他種類克拉夫斯特拉中的兩百隻。』

segments.orig:
aêtahe ýat mazdayasnahe aêtayå nâirikayå
cithravaityå daxshtavaityå vohunavaityå daxshtem
uzverezyât kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti peshô-tanuye
duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe
ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
If a worshipper of Mazda shall suppress the issue of a woman
who has the whites or sees blood, what is the penalty that he
shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He is a Peshotanu: two hundred
stripes with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the
Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
馬茲達的信仰者若壓制患白濁或見血女人的病況，他應當支付的懲罰是多少？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『他是佩紹坦努罪：以馬鞭鞭打二百次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打二百次。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô nâirikayå cithravaityå
daxshtavaityå vohunavaityå paurvô vasna shyaothna
tanûm irithyât ýat hê cithra daxshtem
bavaiti ýat hê daxshta cithrem bavaiti kâ hê
asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall again and again lasciviously touch the body of a woman who
has the whites or sees blood, so that the wlutes turn to the
blood or the blood turns to the whites, what is the penalty that
he shall pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個男人一再地淫慾地觸碰患白濁或見血女人的身體，致使白濁轉為血或血轉為白濁，他應當支付的懲罰是多少？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, paoiryâi upaêta
paoiryâi nishasta thrisatem upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya thrisatem sraoshô-caranaya, bityâi
upaêta bityâi nishasta pañcâsatem upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya pañcâsatem sraoshô-caranaya,
thrityâi upaêta thrityâi nishasta haptâitîm
upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya haptâitîm
sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'For the first time he comes near unto
her, for the first time he lies by her, thirty stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, thirty stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
'For the second time he comes near unto her, for the second
time he lies by her, fifty stripes with the Aspahe-astra, fifty
stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
'For the third time he comes near unto her, for the third
time he lies by her, seventy stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
seventy stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『第一次他靠近她，第一次他與她同臥，以馬鞭鞭打三十次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打三十次。
『第二次他靠近她，第二次他與她同臥，以馬鞭鞭打五十次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打五十次。
『第三次他靠近她，第三次他與她同臥，以馬鞭鞭打七十次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打七十次。』

segments.orig:
[tûiryâi upaêta tûiryâi nishasta
ýim añtare vastrem frajasât ýim añtare
âhitem rânem frajasât afrangharezât pairi
xshudrât kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, navaitîm upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya navaitîm sraoshô-caranaya.]
segments.en:
For the fourth time he comes near unto her, for the fourth
time he lies by her, if he shall press the body under her
clothes, if he shall go in between the unclean thighs, but
without sexual intercourse, what is the penalty that he shall
pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Ninety stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
ninety stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
segments.zh:
第四次他靠近她，第四次他與她同臥，如果他在衣服下壓迫她的身體，如果他介入於不潔的大腿之間，但無性交行為，他應當支付的懲罰是多少？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『以馬鞭鞭打九十次，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打九十次。

segments.orig:
ýô nâirikãm cithravaitîm daxshtavaitîm
vohunavaitîm xshudrå avi frangherezaiti nôit
vanghô ahmât shyaothnem verezyeiti ýadhôit
puthrahe hvâzâtahe frâ naêzem nasûm
pacât paiti ûthem barât.
segments.en:
'Whosover shall lie in sexual intercourse with a woman who
has the whites or sees blood does no better deed than if he
should burn the corpse of his own son, born of his own body and
dead of naeza, and drop its fat into the fire.
segments.zh: 凡與患白帶或見經血的婦女發生性交者，所作所為並不比焚燒自己親生的兒子的屍體——那兒子死於納埃茲疾病——並將其脂肪滴入火中更好。

segments.orig:
vîspe drvañtô tanu-drujô ýô
aderetô tkaêshô vîspe aderetô-tkaêshô
ýô asraoshô vîspe asraoshô ýô
anashavanô vîspe anashavanô ýô
tanu-perethô! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'All wicked, embodiments of the Druj, are scorners of the
judge: all scorners of the judge are rebels against the
Sovereign: all rebels against the Sovereign are ungodly men; and
all ungodly men are worthy of death.'
segments.zh: 凡德魯格的化身、一切邪惡者都是對裁判官的褻瀆者：凡對裁判官的褻瀆者都是對至尊的反叛者：凡對至尊的反叛者都是不敬神的人；而凡不敬神的人都應當死亡。
